name: print-social-be-a-graphic-designer-flyer-navy-with-matisse-cutout-shapes
title: 'Creative Design For A Bright Future' flyer with a duotone portrait and scattered Matisse-style cut-out shapes
whatItIs: A square flyer split between a black-and-white photo of a woman sketching with headphones on, and a navy field scattered with bold flat shapes (a green scalloped blob, an orange starburst, a purple star, a scribbled orange loop) around bold white 'Creative Design For A Bright Future' and pink 'Be A Graphic Designer' headlines.
whatItMeans: Bold and youthful; scattered abstract shapes over a serious portrait make a career-recruitment flyer feel current and creative.
techniques: Split the frame between a real photo and a flat colour field.
Scatter unrelated abstract shapes for energetic texture.
Keep the photo greyscale so the flat shapes carry all colour.

vocabulary.definition: Simple, organic cut-out forms inspired by paper-cut art.
A frame divided between photographic and flat graphic areas.
